## Reproduce

From the repository root:

```bash
python3 plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P03-design-remediation/check.py
```

Requires the existing PHP 8.4/Composer wrapper and sealed provider archives. The script creates its own
HEAD worktree under ignored `build/`, runs the candidate scripts by absolute path, captures logs, and removes
the worktree in `finally`. It runs `apply --no-rector` as a design diagnostic; no product suites or P03 execution.
`results.json` pins HEAD, commands, exit codes and checked script hashes.
